manual_findings.finding: Chamber Geometry contains Design Parameters and Size and Geometry tabs. Sizing requires the determine-size option and at least one sizing basis: nominal thrust, total mass flow, or throat diameter.

Documented configuration inputs include chamber count, nozzle-shape selection, chamber length or characteristic length, contraction angle and normalized contraction radii. Nozzle inlet/exit conditions and nozzle shape are controlled through the Nozzle Flow Model screen.
Size and Geometry displays calculated chamber/nozzle size and thrust-loss information. Results can be saved as ASCII and the chamber contour can be exported to DXF with unit and drawing options.

required_before_run: team-selected provisional candidate and decision record
approved sizing basis and ambient condition
propellant states, chamber pressure and mixture ratio
not_determined_by_rpa_geometry_output: joints, seals, ports, mounts and instrumentation
cooling, supply, structural or combustion safety approval
